# The documented command line of the PostgreSQL restore program, release 17,
# written from its reference page (app-pgrestore).
  -d, --dbname=NAME               database to connect to and restore into
  -f, --file=FILENAME             output file for the script, or - for stdout
  -F, --format=c|d|t              archive format
  -l, --list                      print the table of contents of the archive
  -v, --verbose                   verbose mode
  -V, --version                   print the release
  -a, --data-only                 restore only the data
  -c, --clean                     drop objects before creating them
  -C, --create                    create the database
  -e, --exit-on-error             stop on the first error
  -I, --index=NAME                restore the named index
  -j, --jobs=NUM                  restore with this many parallel jobs
  -L, --use-list=FILENAME         use the table of contents from a file
  -n, --schema=NAME               restore only objects in the schema
  -N, --exclude-schema=NAME       do not restore objects in the schema
  -O, --no-owner                  skip restoration of object ownership
  -P, --function=NAME(args)       restore the named function
  -s, --schema-only               restore only the schema
  -S, --superuser=NAME            superuser name for disabling triggers
  -t, --table=NAME                restore the named relation
  -T, --trigger=NAME              restore the named trigger
  -x, --no-privileges             skip restoration of access privileges
  -1, --single-transaction        restore in a single transaction
  --disable-triggers              disable triggers during a data-only restore
  --enable-row-security           restore with row security on
  --if-exists                     use IF EXISTS when dropping objects
  --no-comments                   do not restore comments
  --no-data-for-failed-tables     skip data of tables that failed to create
  --no-publications               do not restore publications
  --no-security-labels            do not restore security labels
  --no-subscriptions              do not restore subscriptions
  --no-table-access-method        do not restore table access methods
  --no-tablespaces                do not restore tablespace assignments
  --section=SECTION               restore the named section
  --strict-names                  require every name to match something
  --transaction-size=N            commit after this many objects
  --use-set-session-authorization set ownership with SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION
  --filter=FILENAME               read include and exclude rules from a file
  -h, --host=HOSTNAME             server host or socket directory
  -p, --port=PORT                 server port
  -U, --username=NAME             user name to connect as
  -w, --no-password               never prompt for a password
  -W, --password                  force a password prompt
  --role=ROLENAME                 role set before the restore
